Source: https://www.mystoredemo.io/
MyStore Demo is an online payment demonstration platform provided by Adyen. This project uses it as a third-party demonstration and testing environment to simulate product selection and payment flows in an e-commerce scenario. The platform serves only to present the business scenario; it is not part of the core technical implementation and is not counted as team-developed work. The project team independently designs and implements the core functionality and innovations. These files preserve the original bytes of the publicly deployed build. Source URLs and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in SOURCE-MANIFEST.json. Dependency license notices and the Inter font license are retained. Local controller adaptation and Chinese translations live outside this preserved source directory.
The public demo includes product list, product detail, cart, checkout, confirmation, error, and donation/collaborate routes. Adyen payment SDK calls are not a local payment backend and need a separate integration.
